mapper.insert: insert into message_info ( id, user_id, title, content, message_type, is_read, business_id, dedup_key, message_level ) values ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{isRead}, #{businessId}, #{dedupKey}, #{messageLevel} )
mapper.select: select count(*) from message_info where dedup_key = #{dedupKey} and user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0 and is_deleted = 0 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)
select from message_info where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0 order by create_time desc
select count(*) from message_info where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: update message_info set is_read = 1, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0 and is_deleted = 0
